ADDON_DESCRIPTION: Download YouTube videos, playlists, or MP3 audio into a folder with native progress.
INVALID_FOLDER: The download folder does not exist.
DEPENDENCIES: Install yt-dlp and FFmpeg and make both available on PATH. Keep yt-dlp up to date for YouTube support.
OUTDATED_DOWNLOADER: yt-dlp is too old for current YouTube support. Update it using the official yt-dlp installation instructions.
JS_RUNTIME: Install Deno (recommended) or Node.js 22 or newer for YouTube's JavaScript challenges.
INVALID_URL: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS YouTube video or playlist URL.
INVALID_OPTIONS: The download form returned invalid options.
TOOL_ERROR: Could not run the download tool: {error}
